name: com.agentscouthq/directory
title: AgentScout MCP server

dataLocalityFilter: Optional runs_locally filter on search_tools and best_for_task: offline (runs fully on your own machine), self_hosted_or_offline (also tools you can deploy on your own server) or any. Each result has a data_locality label inferred from its listing; verify with the vendor before relying on it for compliance.

tools.name: search_tools

tools.name: get_tool

tools.name: list_categories

tools.name: best_for_task
tools.description: Describe a task in plain words and get the most relevant tools, with optional pricing, open-source and runs_locally filters.

tools.name: list_packages
tools.description: List AgentScout's 4 maker listing & sponsorship tiers ($0 Free, $29 Fast-Track, $49 30-Day Category Pin, $99/wk Weekly Sponsor) with direct Stripe Checkout URLs, plus the Made by AgentScout pre-trained bot catalog.
